_source: Manual curation against Odoo source tree — each version verified against addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/ (bootstrap.css first comment or _variables.scss) and preprocessor file counts (*.less vs *.scss in addons/). See /tmp/osm-survey/v*-ground-truth.md S10 sections for evidence.
_note: Bootstrap major.minor.patch reflects the exact version Odoo ships in addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/ at the head of each N.0 branch. The preprocessor field is the stylesheet language the asset pipeline compiles for that version (Sass indented syntax at v8, LESS v9-v11, SCSS v12+). 'scss_files' lists the stylesheet entry points of that version whatever their language (the field name is kept for schema compatibility). tests/test_bootstrap_versions_source_parity.py checks the version, the entry points and the preprocessor against each real checkout.

breaking_changes: Asset bundles compile Sass (indented .sass syntax, SassAsset in openerp/addons/base/ir/ir_qweb.py); there is no LESS support in the asset pipeline yet.
No standardized brand color overrides; the web client loads base.css (compiled from base.sass), so customization means overriding its rules.
8.0.notes: Bootstrap 3.2.0 LESS source in addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/less/. CSS is precompiled and shipped. Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.js:2 'Bootstrap v3.2.0'.

breaking_changes: Bootstrap bump 3.2.0 -> 3.3.5 - incremental patches, no major API breakage.
Asset bundles compile LESS (LessStylesheetAsset in openerp/addons/base/ir/ir_qweb.py, next to Sass); the web client stylesheets become .less files under addons/web/static/src/less/.
9.0.notes: First Odoo version with a LESS variable layer downstream addons can override (addons/web/static/src/less/variables.less). Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/less/theme.less:1 'Bootstrap v3.3.5'.

breaking_changes: Stylesheet asset bundles introduced (web.assets_backend, web.assets_frontend).
Color/spacing variables consolidated into addons/web/static/src/less/variables.less.
openerp namespace replaced by odoo namespace — HTTP/addons/tools imports changed.
10.0.notes: Still Bootstrap 3.3.5 + LESS. Theme customization targets variables.less. Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.css:1 'Bootstrap v3.3.5'. Known limitation: 3 modules (l10n_fr_sale_closing, account_cash_basis_base_account, l10n_fr_pos_cert) retain __openerp__.py at v10 and are missed by ModernManifestFinder (see ADR-0005 known-miss).

breaking_changes: Python 3 only (Python 2 dropped).
Bootstrap 3.3.5 + LESS retained — the LESS→SCSS migration happens at v12, NOT v11.
11.0.notes: Bootstrap 3.3.5 + LESS. No scss/ directory under addons/web/static/src/ — only less/. Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.css:2 'Bootstrap v3.3.5'; addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/less/bootstrap.less:2 'Bootstrap v3.3.5'. Brand override: @odoo-brand-primary in addons/web/static/src/less/variables.less.

breaking_changes: Major: LESS completely replaced by SCSS. Bootstrap 3 replaced by Bootstrap 4.1.3.
Grid switched from float-based to flexbox; .row/.col-* class behavior differs.
Glyphicons removed — Font Awesome icons used instead.
Many utility class names renamed (e.g. .pull-left → .float-left, .hidden-* → .d-*-none).
All v11 custom LESS themes must be rewritten as SCSS.
bootstrap_overridden.scss introduced as the canonical seam for Bootstrap variable overrides; brand variables live in primary_variables.scss, derived ones in secondary_variables.scss.
Quirk: 5 XML bundle entries still carry type='text/less' on .scss files (v12 source bug — ignored at runtime).
12.0.notes: First version on Bootstrap 4 + SCSS. Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.css:1 'Bootstrap v4.1.3'. Override $primary, $body-bg etc. in bootstrap_overridden.scss.

breaking_changes: Bootstrap bump 4.1.3 → 4.3.1 — utility API expanded ($utilities-* maps), some spacer scales adjusted.
.badge-pill class behavior tightened; rounded-pill recommended.
13.0.notes: Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.css 'Bootstrap v4.3.1'. Last release before website/portal stylesheets were heavily reorganized in v14.

breaking_changes: Bootstrap 4.3.1 retained — no Bootstrap major change at v14.
Website/portal frontend SCSS refactored — website.scss becomes the primary frontend entry.
web_editor stylesheets split into common/backend/frontend bundles.
OWL 1.x introduced alongside legacy web.Widget.
14.0.notes: Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.css 'Bootstrap v4.3.1'. Customizing frontend themes requires touching both website.scss and bootstrap_overridden.scss layers.

breaking_changes: Bootstrap 4.3.1 retained - Bootstrap 5 does NOT arrive until v16.
The web client SCSS (primary_variables.scss / secondary_variables.scss / bootstrap_overridden.scss) moves under addons/web/static/src/legacy/scss/.
Assets dict in __manifest__.py replaces XML template asset bundle declarations.
SCSS only: no .less file left in addons/.
15.0.notes: Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/js/index.js:4 'Bootstrap (v4.3.1)'; addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.css:1 'Bootstrap v4.3.1'. OWL 1.4.11. Override $o-brand-primary in legacy/scss/primary_variables.scss.

breaking_changes: Major: Bootstrap 4.3.1 → 5.1.3. jQuery dropped as a Bootstrap dependency.
Internet Explorer support dropped.
RTL is now built-in via Bootstrap 5 logical properties (no separate RTL stylesheet).
Many components renamed: .form-row removed, .custom-select → .form-select, data-toggle → data-bs-toggle.
OWL 2 introduced — most legacy Widget-based templates migrated to OWL components.
SCSS only: no .less file in addons/.
16.0.notes: Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/js/dist/tab.js:2 'Bootstrap v5.1.3'. OWL 2 (2.8.4 at the branch head). Override $o-brand-primary in primary_variables.scss.

breaking_changes: Bootstrap 5.1.3 retained from v16 — no Bootstrap version bump at v17.
Partial dark-mode story added via data-bs-theme on select components.
Many color tokens migrated from SCSS variables to CSS custom properties (--bs-primary, --bs-body-bg, etc.).
SCSS only: no .less file in addons/.
17.0.notes: Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/js/dist/collapse.js:2 'Bootstrap collapse.js v5.1.3'. For brand customization: override $o-brand-primary in primary_variables.scss for build-time defaults; use --bs-primary CSS variable for runtime/theme-toggle scenarios.

breaking_changes: Bootstrap bump 5.1.3 → 5.3.3. Native color modes (light/dark) via data-bs-theme.
CSS custom properties ($variable-prefix: bs-) — deprecated in v5.2.0; $prefix is the new form.
border-radius-2xl CSS variable deprecated in v5.3.0.
<tree> → <list> view tag hard rename (ir.ui.view.type stores 'list', not 'tree').
SCSS only: no .less file in addons/.
18.0.notes: Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.css:3 'Bootstrap v5.3.3'. Bulk of v18 frontend churn is OWL component-level, not Bootstrap-level.

breaking_changes: Bootstrap 5.3.3 retained from v18 — no Bootstrap version bump at v19.
ORM package split (odoo/orm/ with 23 files) — parser must use _resolve_core_paths for v19.
SCSS only: no .less file in addons/.
CSS-custom-property-first theming approach increasingly favored over SCSS-variable overrides.
19.0.notes: Evidence: addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.css:3 'Bootstrap v5.3.3'. Theming guidance: prefer runtime CSS custom properties (--bs-*, --o-*) when targeting a multi-theme deployment; reserve SCSS overrides for fixed brand defaults.

breaking_changes: Bootstrap 5.3.3 retained from v19 - no Bootstrap version bump at v20.
Owl 3 replaces Owl 2 (addons/web/static/lib/owl/owl.js: 3.0.0 pre-release, was 2.8.4): components declare props with useProps(...) instead of `static props`.
jQuery and QUnit are no longer shipped in addons/web/static/lib/ (frontend tests are Hoot only).
SCSS only: no .less file in addons/.
20.0.notes: Evidence (odoo/odoo 20.0 at 530bc2789e2f): addons/web/static/lib/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.css:3 'Bootstrap v5.3.3'; the five SCSS entry points above exist unchanged. Theming guidance is unchanged from v19: prefer runtime CSS custom properties (--bs-*, --o-*) for multi-theme deployments; reserve SCSS overrides for fixed brand defaults.
